package.title: Tempo.Blazor.Maps
package.description: Leaflet powered interactive map components for Tempo.Blazor with bundled OpenStreetMap tiles support, Canvas-rendered marker batches, and marker clustering.

gettingStarted.title: Tempo.Blazor.Maps
gettingStarted.overview: Leaflet powered interactive map components for Tempo.Blazor with bundled OpenStreetMap tiles support, Canvas-rendered marker batches, and marker clustering.

items.description: Interactive Leaflet map with OpenStreetMap tiles. Leaflet 1.9.4 and leaflet.markercluster 1.5.3 are bundled with the package (no CDN dependency) and loaded lazily by the ES module. Marker batches render through a Canvas renderer; data sets (markers/clusters) are swapped atomically. Supports client-side clustering, server-side aggregated cluster bubbles, and an optional IMapDataProvider with debounced, cancellable viewport loading.

parameters.name: CenterLatitude
parameters.description: Latitude of the initial map center in decimal degrees. Defaults to the Czech Republic centroid.

parameters.name: CenterLongitude
parameters.description: Longitude of the initial map center in decimal degrees. Defaults to the Czech Republic centroid.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the root element.

parameters.name: ClusterPoints
parameters.description: Server-side aggregated cluster points rendered as count bubbles. A cluster with Count = 1 renders as a plain marker. Replacing the list atomically re-renders all clusters.

parameters.name: DataProvider
parameters.description: Optional data source: when set, the component requests fresh points after the viewport settles (debounced by DataRequestDebounceMs), cancelling the superseded request. The component stays fully usable without a provider (imperative mode).

parameters.name: DataRequestDebounceMs
parameters.description: Debounce interval in milliseconds for provider requests after pan/zoom. Defaults to 300.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: CSS height of the map container (any CSS length). Defaults to 400px.

parameters.name: Markers
parameters.description: Markers rendered on the map via the Canvas renderer. Markers with a duplicate non-null Id are de-duplicated (the first occurrence wins). Replacing the list atomically re-renders all markers.

parameters.name: MaxZoom
parameters.description: Maximum zoom level offered by the tile layer. Defaults to 19.

parameters.name: OnClusterClick
parameters.description: Raised when a cluster is clicked: for server-side clusters the payload carries the cluster key and count; for client-side (markercluster) groups the key is null.

parameters.name: OnDataError
parameters.description: Raised when DataProvider throws; the map stays usable and keeps its last data.

parameters.name: OnMapClick
parameters.description: Raised when the map background is clicked. The payload carries the clicked coordinates and current zoom.

parameters.name: OnMarkerClick
parameters.description: Raised when a marker is clicked. The payload carries the marker id and coordinates.

parameters.name: OnZoomChanged
parameters.description: Raised after the zoom level changes. The payload carries the new center and zoom.

parameters.name: TileUrlTemplate
parameters.description: Tile layer URL template. Defaults to the public OpenStreetMap tile server.

parameters.name: UseClientClustering
parameters.description: When true, Markers are grouped client-side with leaflet.markercluster (spiderfy on max zoom, zoom-to-bounds on cluster click).

parameters.name: Zoom
parameters.description: Initial Leaflet zoom level. Fractional values are supported. Defaults to 7.5 (whole Czech Republic).

methods.name: SetViewAsync
methods.description: Moves the map to the given center and zoom without animation.

methods.name: GetViewportAsync
methods.description: Reads the current map center and zoom.

methods.name: SetMarkersAsync
methods.description: Atomically replaces all declarative data with the supplied marker batch (Canvas rendered).

methods.name: SetClusterPointsAsync
methods.description: Atomically replaces all declarative data with the supplied server-side cluster points.

methods.name: AddMarkersAsync
methods.description: Adds a batch of Canvas markers on top of the current content.

methods.name: AddClusterGroupAsync
methods.description: Creates an empty client-side cluster group (leaflet.markercluster) and returns its id.

methods.name: AddMarkerToClusterAsync
methods.description: Adds a single marker into a client-side cluster group.

methods.name: AddMarkersToClusterAsync
methods.description: Adds a batch of markers into a client-side cluster group.

methods.name: ClearMarkersAsync
methods.description: Removes all markers, cluster groups, and data layers from the map.

methods.name: InvalidateSizeAsync
methods.description: Recalculates the map size. Call after the map container becomes visible again (e.g. hidden tab).

methods.name: RefreshDataAsync
methods.description: Requests fresh data from DataProvider immediately (bypasses the debounce). No-op without a provider.

examples.title: Basic map with markers
examples.code:
<TmMap CenterLatitude="49.8175"
       CenterLongitude="15.473"
       Zoom="7.5"
       Height="480px"
       Markers="@markers"
       OnMarkerClick="HandleMarkerClick" />
